options.label: Accept the relaxed system; the contacts are left to equilibration
trade_offs: Marginal contacts after a restrained minimization usually resolve during equilibration, but that is not checked here.
The contacts stay listed in the record for later review.

options.label: Needs expert review (for example a weaker restraint or another rotamer)
trade_offs: A human decides whether the protocol or the rotamer should change.

findings.rationale: Relaxation moves side chains and waters within the shell under strong positional restraints (TASK-006), so close contacts can remain. They are judged with the variant_build criterion and reported, not hidden; clashes only flag (maintainer, TASK-005 review). One finding per relaxed system that still has clashes at a mutated residue.
